description: Runs the open-source hefesto-ai engine (`hefesto analyze --no-config`, free tier) on the files you send to the hosted analyzer and returns its findings: rule id, severity, file, line, message and the SARIF hefestoFingerprint/v1 fingerprint (format "sarif" adds the full SARIF 2.1.0 log). Use it to check a file or snippet the user shares (for example "analyze this file") for security and quality issues before committing. Try it: {"code":"password = \"Sup3rS3cret!2026\""} returns a HARDCODED_SECRET finding. Minimum call: {"code": "<file contents>"}. Add path (e.g. "app/run.py") so the language comes from the extension; without path or language the language is inferred from the content, else python. For several files send files=[{"path", "content"}] instead. severity and format are optional. Covers Python, COBOL, the DevOps/IaC formats hefesto analyze routes, and TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust and C# through the multilang tree-sitter grammars (the first such request on a fresh server instance downloads the grammars and can take a few seconds longer). Limits: 20 files, 100 KB per file, 256 KB in total, 20 seconds, 10 requests per minute per IP, shared across server instances. No .hefesto.yaml is read. Files are deleted after the run; nothing is stored. For a whole repository, run `hefesto analyze .` locally.

inputSchema.description: Send code (one file; path and language optional) or files (several). Everything else is optional.

code.description: Contents of one file or snippet, used when files is omitted. At most 100 KB. This is the only argument a first call needs.

files.description: Several files to analyze. Used instead of code when present. path: relative POSIX, at most 200 characters and 8 levels; each segment is letters, digits, "_", "." or "-" and must not start with "-"; no "..", no absolute paths, no ".git" or ".hefesto.yaml". content: UTF-8 text, no NUL bytes, at most 100 KB.

content.description: UTF-8 source text. At most 100 KB. No NUL bytes.

path.description: Relative POSIX path. The extension picks the language.

format.description: Optional. json (default): findings only; sarif: also the full SARIF 2.1.0 log.

language.description: Optional language of code. Ignored when files or path is set. When omitted it is inferred from the content (python if unsure). An unknown language is rejected; send path or files instead.

path.description: Optional file name for code, e.g. "app/run.py" or "Dockerfile". The extension picks the language. Same rules as files[].path. Ignored when files is set.

severity.description: Optional minimum severity to report (default LOW).

name: analyze

outputSchema.description: ok true carries the hosted analyzer body in analysis. ok false carries error and message. On success the content text is the summary and the analyzer JSON. On failure the content text is the error sentence only.

analysis.description: Analyzer JSON. The content text is a one-line summary plus this object.

error.description: Failure code when ok is false. invalid_json when the analyzer body was not JSON.

message.description: Same string as content[0].text when ok is false.

ok.description: true when the engine returned analyzed: true.

title: Analyze code
